beats.text: Handheld camera behind the moving scooter on a sunny hedge-lined road. The golden retriever passenger holds one foreleg high; a dog paw from the right edge rubs a vanilla ice-cream bar back and forth deep in its armpit fur, smearing white cream; at 1.5-2.2 the retriever lifts its paw to its face, grimacing, a white cream streak on its cheek.
Fast whip-pan to the front: the Shiba driver turns its head back toward camera and laughs with its mouth wide open (2.3-2.8), then fast whip-pan back.
Back on the armpit: the paw keeps rubbing, the ice cream bar is melting and dripping down the furry belly; the retriever looks away in disgust.
Hard cut to an extreme close-up of the armpit fur with the crushed, melting ice-cream bar (comedic freeze frame, nothing moves).
Wide: a bystander dog walks past on the sidewalk and stares; the Shiba driver is still laughing.
PUNCHLINE: the paw shoves the same armpit ice-cream bar into the laughing Shiba driver's open mouth; it bites down.
The Shiba keeps riding with the ice-cream stick hanging out of its mouth, chewing, unaware.
The retriever hops off the back; the scooter wobbles and bumps into a big grey plastic trash bin, which tips over (8.1-8.3).
Hard cut to a close-up of the Shiba driver's face: mouth wide open in a disgusted scream, full of white ice cream (comedic freeze frame, nothing moves).
Wide: the scooter tips, the trash bin rolls on the pavement, the retriever stumbles beside it.

board_notes: golden retriever passenger with a fully furry body and raised furry foreleg (NO bare human skin, no human arm), a dog paw rubbing the ice-cream bar in its armpit; Shiba driver in white mesh shirt in front.
the Shiba driver turned back toward the camera, laughing with mouth wide open, white mesh shirt, furry paws on the handlebars.
extreme close-up of golden retriever armpit fur with a crushed melting vanilla ice-cream bar and white drips; the holding hand is a furry dog paw; no human skin.
a furry dog paw pushes the ice-cream bar into the open mouth of the Shiba driver (white mesh shirt), Shiba eyes squeezed shut.
the Shiba driver on the black scooter bumping into a big grey plastic trash bin; the golden retriever jumping off behind; furry legs only.
close-up of the Shiba driver's face, mouth wide open in a disgusted scream full of white ice cream, white mesh shirt.
